items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No, we didn't have George Duvivier, we had a guy they called "The Bruiser."

ctx.x: And to hear him play with Dorothy Donegan was...she was fantastic and so was he, so...I think that you'd consider that... I'd consider it and classify it as a game of skill, have the two of them playing together, you know, as they did. As recently as 1975 I made some records with J. C. and Doc Cheatham, with Ted Buckner before he died--Milt Buckner's brother. And, who else did we have. We had...who did we have on bass?... DM: George Duvivier?
No, we didn't have George Duvivier, we had a guy they called "The Bruiser." I can't remember his name but I can
give it to you later. But he was a...
